outputs.discrepancies: The caption states the split-GFP assay uses 'a PacL1-GFP11 fusion protein together with GFP1-10 (control) or the indicated proteins fused to GFP11...or GFP1-10', but the x-axis condition labels in the panel are 'Control', 'PacL2/CtpG^MBD', and 'PacL2^Δ55-84/CtpG^MBD'. The panel actually tests PacL2 (and its Δ55-84 deletion) interaction with CtpG's membrane-binding domain, not a PacL1-GFP11 fusion as the caption describes.

Minor note: the statistical-reference list at the end of the caption lists the reference condition for panel (I) under a duplicated label '(D) CtpCmV (PacL1WT)' instead of '(I)', which is likely a typographical mislabeling in the caption text rather than an issue with the image itself.
